title: Cluster join on the LAN with mDNS and a confirmation
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Discover other susi hosts by mDNS and join after a one-time confirmation that exchanges the cluster key epoch, replacing manual enrollment. Tests zc_lan_cluster_*.
